question: Should the active-snapshot wrapped web-provider failure path be repaired and covered before approving this Vault diagnostic-contract change?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes provider-authentication failure classification and logs; the remaining path crosses a wrapped runtime error whose intended aggregation behavior needs an owner-confirmed compatibility decision.

options.title: Repair the wrapped-error path
options.body: Aggregate `providerFailures` from associated unavailable owners when logging thrown web-provider errors, and prove the active-snapshot scenario.

options.title: Accept owner-scoped diagnostics there
options.body: Document that active-snapshot web-provider failures remain owner-scoped and accept that they do not use the new aggregate event.

recommendation.title: Repair the wrapped-error path
recommendation.body: Aggregate `providerFailures` from associated unavailable owners when logging thrown web-provider errors, and prove the active-snapshot scenario.
